workload.name: namespace-counts
workload.sql: SELECT coalesce(n.value,'') AS key,sum(c.n) AS n FROM (SELECT namespace,count(*) AS n FROM line GROUP BY namespace) c LEFT JOIN string n ON n.id=c.namespace GROUP BY coalesce(n.value,'') ORDER BY n.utf16

workload.name: culture-state-counts
workload.sql: SELECT t.name AS culture,c.state AS state,c.n AS n FROM (SELECT culture,state,count(*) AS n FROM line_culture GROUP BY culture,state) c JOIN culture t ON t.id=c.culture ORDER BY culture,state

namespace-counts.detail: CO-ROUTINE c
SCAN line USING COVERING INDEX line_namespace
SCAN c
SEARCH n USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?) LEFT-JOIN
USE TEMP B-TREE FOR GROUP BY
USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

culture-state-counts.detail: CO-ROUTINE c
SCAN line_culture USING COVERING INDEX culture_state
SCAN t
BLOOM FILTER ON c (culture=?)
SEARCH c USING AUTOMATIC COVERING INDEX (culture=?)
USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY
